blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III hailed the approval of the reconciled version of the proposed National Children’s Nutrition Act by the bicameral conference committee, calling it more than a legislative achievement an investment in the health, dignity, and future of every Filipino child. The bill was passed as the country observes National Children’s Month. “I believe that the most valuable legacy that we can give the next generation is the opportunity for them to grow healthy, strong, and with a good future,” Dy said in Filipino. “Hunger and malnutrition should not become barriers to the dreams of […]...
